mapper.insert:
insert into notify_delivery ( delivery_id, intent_id, recipient_id, user_id, channel, target_value, status, attempt_count, provider_key, provider_message_id, error_code, error_message, accepted_at, receipt_query_at, delivered_at, read_at, version, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values
(#{row.deliveryId}, #{row.intentId}, #{row.recipientId}, #{row.userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{row.channel}, #{row.targetValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.status}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.providerKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.providerMessageId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.acceptedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.receiptQueryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.deliveredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.readAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.version}, #{row.createDept,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{row.createBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: select d.* from notify_delivery d join notify_channel_account a on a.channel = 'SMS' and a.config_key = d.provider_key where d.channel = 'SMS' and d.status = 'ACCEPTED' and d.provider_message_id is not null and d.provider_message_id <> '' and d.accepted_at <= timestampadd(second, -60, #{now}) and d.accepted_at > timestampadd(hour, -71, #{now}) and (d.receipt_query_at is null or d.receipt_query_at <= #{now}) and a.enabled = 'Y' and a.del_flag = '0' and a.supplier in ('tencent', 'alibaba') order by coalesce(d.receipt_query_at, d.accepted_at), d.delivery_id limit 1
